title: Active learning identified a KNN ceramic composition with high piezoelectric response
summary: An active-learning loop combined machine-learning prediction, surrogate optimization and experimental testing to explore lead-free potassium-sodium niobate (KNN) ceramics. After three experiment and optimization iterations, the authors report identifying a composition with a measured piezoelectric coefficient d33 of approximately 353 pC/N from thousands of possible compositions. This is a laboratory material-property measurement, not validation of a finished sensor or device.
ai_technology: Support vector regression with a radial basis function kernel in an active-learning experimental-design loop
organization: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

evidence.ai_role: An SVR model predicted KNN piezoelectric response and guided composition selection across three experiment-optimization iterations.
